description: Documents the specific error scenario of API-069 (Create Sample Collection) where sampleCondition is not a recognized value. Same endpoint as API-069, isolated here to preserve the docs/API_Contracts_and_Test_Results.xlsx functionality numbering.

body.sampleCondition: 'INVALID_CONDITION' - not a valid sample_condition value in this scenario

validation: sampleCondition must be one of GOOD, HEMOLYZED, CLOTTED, LEAKING, INSUFFICIENT, DAMAGED (CHECK)

success.status_definition: N/A - this functionality ID documents only the failure path; see API-069 for the success contract

errors.condition: sampleCondition is not one of the allowed enum values

constraints: sample_condition VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'GOOD' CHECK IN (GOOD, HEMOLYZED, CLOTTED, LEAKING, INSUFFICIENT, DAMAGED)
